parts:
Hi Shiny Community,

I have developed a neuroscience education based shiny app which is hosted for free at https://neuron.shinyapps.io/panama-master/ .
The funding for it has run out. I would still like to make it available to large number of people. 

Could I write a proposal to Rstudio and they could help me get the app running for longer active hours ?

I am from the university of oklahoma. I am a graduate student here.

Thanks,
Anuj
